title: Fabric classification — what the classifier agent suggests about one artifact

subject_confidence.description: How sure you are of EACH subject, keyed by the id you returned. One can be certain while another is a guess, which a single confidence for the whole classification cannot say. Anything below the deployment's floor never becomes a link.

references.description: Other DOCUMENTS this one cites, each spelled as the text spells it — 'ADR-041 Prescription identifier format', not a paraphrase and not an IRI. Only a document you can see named in the excerpt; never one you infer from the subject matter. The fabric resolves each against the catalogue and links only an unambiguous match, so a citation it cannot place is dropped rather than guessed — give it the words on the page and let it decide. OPTIONAL, deliberately: a citation is evidence, not a gate — a classification that omits it is a weaker answer, not an invalid one, and failing a whole run over a missing list would make the pipeline more brittle for a secondary field.
